# Central African Republic — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the capital of Central African Republic?", "Bangui"),
    ("What currency does Central African Republic use?", "CFA Franc"),
    ("What is capital?", "Bangui"),
    ("What is currency?", "CFA Franc (XAF)"),
    ("What is calling code?", "+236"),
    ("What is internet domain?", ".cf"),
    ("What is driving side?", "right"),
    ("What is continent?", "Africa"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
